d: Jeremy Wade investigates a case in Nepal that sounds strangely familiar - a lone fisherman dragged off his feet and into a mountain river by the original river monster, the goonch catfish.
Jeremy Wade is on a mission to track down the famous Loch Ness monster. The journey takes him from the depths of the famous Scottish loch to the volcanoes of Iceland.
Extreme angler Jeremy Wade is on the trail of a monster that leads him to the site of the worst nuclear accident in history - Chernobyl.
Biologist and extreme angler Jeremy Wade travels to Germany where he meets modern-day victims of a beast that has been on the prowl in these waters for the past 700 years.
Jeremy Wade encounters the Amazon's legendary arapaima, one of the largest freshwater fishes in the world.
Jeremy Wade is in Papua New Guinea to investigate a spate of bizarre deaths on the Sepik River. He finds himself on the trail of a creature said to devour certain male body parts.
Jeremy is in Africa's Rift Valley to explore the roots of fishing and the monsters these fishermen faced. A dangerous place, but one with a worthy prize: the Mputa, also known as Nile Perch.
A behind-the-scenes episode where Jeremy reveals just what it takes to move river monsters into the open ocean and the crew opens up about their struggles on board.
Jeremy explores the legend of a lake monster in Alaska. Can he succeed where other hunters have failed and hook the beast, or will he find he is out of his depth?

Daring biologist and extreme fisherman Jeremy Wade travels to Guyana in South America in search of a terrifying river monster believed to be responsible for the mysterious disappearance of several people.

On the tropical island of Sulawesi, Indonesia, a tourist snorkeller and several local fishermen have been killed and injured by a mysterious sea creature that impales its victims. Wade travels to the scene to investigate.
Jeremy Wade homes in on a predator now invading America's backyards. Said to breathe air and crawl on land, the snakehead is rumoured to be able to kill a human.
Wade faces one of his greatest fears to uncover increasing missing persons cases.

Two men mysteriously vanish on a remote lake in Malaysia just hours apart. Amid rumours that a giant fish is on the loose, biologist and monster-hunter Jeremy Wade sets out to track down the possible culprit.
Jeremy Wade is in Brazil's cattle country in search of a beast that has already killed three cowboys. Locals fear for Jeremy as he discovers the shocking truth about this frightening fish.
Jeremy Wade takes on Africa's wild Zambezi River to unmask an invisible predator that is dragging fisherman to their deaths.
For years fishermen have been vanishing in Alaska's remote wilderness. For Jeremy Wade, a recent incident sends him on a search for possible suspects.
Jeremy investigates the case of a Bolivian man who had his face ripped off by a ferocious river predator, leading to a showdown with an old adversary.
Wade comes face-to-face with one of South America's greatest freshwater fighting fish.
